name: creator-hero
title: Creator hero
description: A link-in-bio opening for a creator: avatar, handle, a line of bio, three audience numbers and a column of link buttons, designed at 320px.
docs: Give name, handle, bio and an optional square avatar (without one the initials are drawn). stats are numbers, not strings: 48200 is shown as 48.2K in the locale you pass and read in full to a screen reader. links is the stack of buttons: a label, an href, an icon from @rhs-ui/icons, an optional badge ("new", "beta" or "soon") and featured for the one link to set in solid colour. A link to an absolute http(s) address opens in a new tab with rel="noopener noreferrer" and says so to screen readers; pass external to override. socials are profiles named in text, not logos. Use nameAs="h1" when the hero opens the page, and labels to translate the fixed words.
